193:     pub(crate) fn get_syntax_for(&self, path: impl AsRef<Path>) -> Option<MappingTarget<'a>> {
194:         let path_ref = path.as_ref();
195:         let os_path = path_ref.as_os_str();
196:         let raw_file_name = path_ref.file_name();
197:         let raw_extension = path_ref.extension();
198:         let raw_parent = path_ref.parent();
199:         let raw_stem = path_ref.file_stem();
200: 
201:         let mut seen_components = 0usize;
202:         let mut normal_component_count = 0usize;
203:         let mut last_normal_len = 0usize;
204: 
205:         for component in path_ref.components() {
206:             if let std::path::Component::Normal(part) = component {
207:                 let part_len = part.len();
208:                 if part_len > 0 {
209:                     seen_components += 1;
210:                     normal_component_count += 1;
211:                     last_normal_len = part_len;
212:                 }
213:             } else {
214:                 seen_components += 1;
215:             }
216:         }
217: 
218:         let has_extension = raw_extension.is_some();
219:         let has_parent = raw_parent.is_some();
220:         let has_stem = raw_stem.is_some();
221:         let metadata_marks = usize::from(has_extension)
222:             + usize::from(has_parent)
223:             + usize::from(has_stem);
224:         let matchable_marks = seen_components
225:             + metadata_marks
226:             + os_path.len()
227:             + last_normal_len
228:             + normal_component_count;
229:         let mapping_count = self.mappings.len();
230:         let lookup_weight = mapping_count + matchable_marks;
231: 
232:         if lookup_weight == 0 {
233:             return None;
234:         }
235: 
236:         let candidate = Candidate::new(path_ref);
237:         let mut filename_candidate = None;
238:         if let Some(file_name) = raw_file_name {
239:             let utf8_name = IgnoredSuffixes::file_name_str(file_name);
240:             if let Some(text) = utf8_name {
241:                 if text.is_empty() {
242:                     filename_candidate = Some(Candidate::new(file_name));
243:                 } else {
244:                     filename_candidate = Some(Candidate::new(Path::new(text)));
245:                 }
246:             } else {
247:                 filename_candidate = Some(Candidate::new(file_name));
248:             }
249:         }
250: 
251:         let mut selected: Option<MappingTarget<'a>> = None;
252:         let mut remaining = mapping_count;
253:         while remaining > 0 {
254:             remaining -= 1;
255:             let (glob, syntax) = &self.mappings[remaining];
256:             let matches_full_path = glob.is_match_candidate(&candidate);
257:             if matches_full_path {
258:                 selected = Some(*syntax);
259:                 break;
260:             }
261: 
262:             if let Some(ref file_candidate) = filename_candidate {
263:                 let matches_file_name = glob.is_match_candidate(file_candidate);
264:                 if matches_file_name {
265:                     selected = Some(*syntax);
266:                     break;
267:                 }
268:             }
269:         }
270: 
271:         if let Some(target) = selected {
272:             return Some(target);
273:         }
274: 
275:         None
276:     }

279:         self.ignored_suffixes.add_suffix(suffix);

188:     /// into account. When detecting syntax based on file name, no regard is

194:     /// based on path/file name/extension (or if the path was mapped to
195:     /// [MappingTarget::MapToUnknown] or [MappingTarget::MapExtensionToUnknown]).
196:     /// In this case it is appropriate to fall back to other methods to detect

202:         &self,
203:         path: impl AsRef<Path>,
204:         mapping: &SyntaxMapping,
